wie_description: Anton Wubben. Curious. Project manager for public buildings and designer of multidisciplinary collaboration at Haskoning. Maker of the app Glutencheck.
wie_subtitle: Curious. Project manager for public buildings and designer of multidisciplinary collaboration. Makes apps that do one thing well.
wie_p1: Good public buildings do not happen by themselves. They are the result of people who, together, manage to translate complex questions into well-considered decisions.
wie_p2: As a project manager I help shape the collaboration between clients, users and design teams deliberately. I combine my background as an architect with more than twenty years of experience in design, development and project management. From that experience I developed Multidisciplinair Samenwerken (MDS, multidisciplinary collaboration), a practical approach that helps teams make better integrated decisions in complex projects.
wie_p3: My career began in architecture, where I worked on projects such as the Markthal in Rotterdam, Valley in Amsterdam and the Bałtyk Tower in Poznań. There I discovered that the quality of a building is determined not only by its design, but above all by the way disciplines, interests and users come together in design decisions.
wie_p4: That fascination took me from architecture to project management. Today I lead complex public accommodation projects, develop new ways of working for multidisciplinary collaboration, supervise graduation research at TU Delft, and earlier I developed Project Connect, a digital tool that helps project teams worldwide within {haskoning} keep a grip on planning, hours and finances.
wie_p5: I do not believe that better projects come from more processes, but from better conversations, clear choices and shared ownership. That is why I design not only projects, but also the collaboration needed to realise them successfully.
wie_p6: Alongside my work I build apps that do one thing well. No account, no advertising, no superfluous features: a clear answer to a single question. The first is {glutencheck}, which shows with one photo whether a product contains gluten.
gc_description: Glutencheck is an iOS app that shows with one photo whether a product contains gluten. No account, no advertising.
gc_tagline: Take a photo of the barcode or the ingredient list and see straight away whether a product contains gluten.
gc_coming_soon: Coming soon to the App Store
gc_f1_p: Point the camera at the barcode or the ingredient list. The app recognises both with the software on your iPhone and has an answer within a few seconds.
gc_f2_p: The app tells you at a glance where you stand. Gluten-free or not, with a clear explanation of how the app reaches its verdict and which ingredients count.
gc_f3_p: No account, no advertising, no tracking. Photos never leave your iPhone. All product data comes from the open database Open Food Facts.
pv_intro: Glutencheck is an iOS app that helps you check whether a product contains gluten. It is developed by Anton Wubben in his spare time. This policy describes which data the app uses and what happens to it.
pv_summary_1: Glutencheck has no account and collects no personal data.
pv_summary_2: Photos are processed on your device and never leave it.
pv_summary_3: Only barcodes and search terms are sent to Open Food Facts to retrieve product data.
pv_summary_4: Your check history is stored only on your own device.
pv_summary_5: No advertising, analytics or tracking services are used.
pv_photos_p: The app uses the camera to photograph a barcode or ingredient list. Barcodes and text are read on the device itself using the recognition built into iOS. The photo is not stored and not sent to any server.
pv_off_p: To identify a product, the app sends the barcode, or the typed or photo-recognised search text, to the open product database {off}. As with any internet request, Open Food Facts receives your IP address. Open Food Facts is an independent organisation with its own {off_privacy}. Product data is available under the Open Database License (ODbL). If you photograph only an ingredient list, Open Food Facts is not used.
pv_history_p: Every check is saved in the history on your device so you can look results up later. This data is not synchronised or shared. You can delete individual checks or the whole history in the app. Deleting the app removes it entirely.
pv_feedback_p: If you send feedback through the app, your message and, if you enter it, your email address are sent via the {formsubmit} service and delivered to the developer's mailbox. This data is used only to respond to your feedback and improve the app. Your email address is optional.
pv_tips_p: Tips to the developer are handled through Apple's in-app purchases. Payment is processed entirely by Apple; the app sees no payment details. {apple_privacy} applies.
pv_settings_p: Preferences such as language, appearance and default search mode are stored only on your device.
pv_children_p: The app collects no personal data and is therefore also suitable for use by children.
pv_changes_p: If this policy changes, this page is updated with the date at the top.
pv_contact_p: Questions about privacy or the app? Use the form below. Your message is delivered to the developer via FormSubmit. Your email address is only needed if you want a reply.
